senses.gloss: m. (popular abridgment of Dupondium or Dipondium) Dupondium, a Roman coin equal to two Asses.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 4:8">Maas. Sh. IV, 8</cite> <he>והלך … הוא יוצא בפ׳</he> and he went to another place where the Isar (As) is worth a Dupondium.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:11">Kel. XVII, 11</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="K00664"><he>כִּכָּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 4:5:2">Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ</cite> top <he>שני איסרין פ׳</he> two Isars are one Dupondium. Ib. III, beg. 54ᵃ (not <he>פונדיין</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:23">Y. Kidd. I, 58ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 5:12">Tosef. B. Bath. V, 12</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="M02070"><he>מְעָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 4:13">Tosef. Maas. Sh. IV, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ma'aser Sheni 3:6">Ib. III, 6</cite>; a. fr.—Bekh. l. c. <he>פּוּנְדִּינִין</he>.
